int_name: N BROAD ST & W ROCKLAND ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial with a marked zebra crosswalk and signalized intersection. While sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the long crossing distance across four travel lanes without a refuge island increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, the zebra crosswalk spanning the width of the road.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Separation
hazards.description: There is no physical buffer (like bollards or planters) between the sidewalk and the high-capacity roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island in the center of the crosswalk to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-leg intersection in a mixed-use urban area with significant deficiencies in pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks are present, there are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps visible at this wide crossing, forcing pedestrians to navigate vehicle traffic without dedicated protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at a wide intersection, reducing driver awareness of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated walk/don't walk signals for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles on the corners

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner can block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add pedestrian countdown signals synchronized with the traffic lights to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile warning strips and sloped ramps to ensure the intersection is accessible for all users.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane commercial corridor with high-visibility continental crosswalks and signalized control. However, the long crossing distance across four or more lanes without a refuge island and the presence of on-street parking near the intersection create significant exposure and visibility risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four travel lanes plus parking lanes without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, spanning the width of the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side of the image may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, along the curb line near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with mixed-use and institutional buildings. While a marked crosswalk and traffic signals are present, the wide turning radii and lack of curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner near the laundromat has a wide radius that allows vehicles to turn at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground corner near the laundromat

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right side of the street may obscure pedestrians waiting to cross from the driver's perspective.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, background

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
